summary: Flowserve Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $500M aggregate principal amount of 5.700% Senior Notes due 2036 under a supplemental indenture. The notes pay semi-annual interest and mature May 15, 2036. A special mandatory redemption at 101% of principal plus accrued interest applies if the Trillium Flow Technologies Valves Division acquisition is not consummated by February 4, 2027 or the purchase agreement is terminated. Prior to February 15, 2036, Flowserve may redeem at the greater of make-whole at Treasury plus 20 bps or par. This is a debt financing filing, not a standalone special situation event.
